Each Sunday you'll hear verse-by-verse preaching from God's Word.

Whether you're growing in your faith or serving God's church, my prayer is that every episode equips you to know Christ more deeply, faithfully serve His church, and live for His glory.

title: Growing Interest with Mary Holland Nader
author: Dear Media
description: Join Mary Holland Nader as she explores her curiosity and passion for how psychology, habits, and real-life behaviors shape how we earn and spend. Through thoughtful conversations with experts, professionals, and her famous friends - plus behind-the-scenes insights from her own life as a former investment manager, founder, and reality personality - each episode will deliver practical, doable shifts that make financial wellness feel less overwhelming and more human.

title: No Permission
author: Daniel Druger
description: No Permission is where young founders tell their stories, about the businesses they've created that nobody believed in at first - except them. Host Daniel Druger sits down with entrepreneurs who had more conviction than credentials, more vision than validation, and a very healthy dose of delusion to go all in and build something real. This isn't 'How I Built This', this is 'How I'm Building This', made for the next generation of founders. Every episode is proof that you don't need experience, connections, or permission to start.

title: The Christine Beard Leadership Collection
author: Christine Beard
description:
Practical leadership for people responsible for people, performance and results.

Leadership isn't complicated because we don't know enough theories. It's complicated because it involves people.

The Christine Beard Leadership Collection explores the everyday work of leading and managing well — building capable people, creating accountability, having the conversations you'd rather avoid, developing managers who can think for themselves, and building businesses that don't depend on one person holding everything together.

Christine Beard is a business coach who has spent years working alongside business owners and leaders dealing with the real problems that come with managing people and growing businesses.

No management theatre. No leadership heroics. Just practical ideas, questions and tools to help you become a better leader — and build stronger leaders underneath you.

No jargon. No slides. Just two voices, one very patched-together org, and the eternal question: is it a feature, or is it alive?

title: Echoes in the Static
author: Callum Sterling
description: What lies between what we know and what we feel?Echoes in the Static explores the space where urban legend, human psychology, and personal mystery intersect. Guided by British storyteller Callum Sterling, the show takes listeners on an atmospheric journey through uncanny events, lost audio, forgotten historical anomalies, and psychological phenomena that defy simple explanations.Rather than chasing jump scares or cheap thrills, Echoes in the Static treats mystery as a lens to understand human emotion—exploring isolation, grief, hope, and memory through immersive sound design and compelling narrative arcs.Whether you're listening on a late-night drive or during a quiet evening at home, plug in your headphones and discover what’s hidden inside the static.

title: Haus of God
author: Storie Haus
description: Welcome to Haus of God, a Christ-centered podcast inviting you to build strong foundations in Jesus Christ. Through honest questions, generational wisdom, and practical encouragement, each episode equips you to build a life that looks more like Christ.

title: The Grimdark Historian: A Warhammer 40K Lorecast
author: Dr Jason Edwards
description:
In the Grim Darkness of the Far Future there is only History. Explore the vast, violent, and endlessly fascinating universe of Warhammer 40,000 (W40K) through an educational audio-documentary series dedicated to the history, factions, characters, wars, worlds, technology, and mysteries of the 41st Millennium. Each season takes a focused journey into Warhammer 40K lore, examining subjects ranging from the Imperium of Man, Space Marines, Primarchs, and the Horus Heresy to Chaos, the Aeldari, Necrons, Orks, Tyranids, T’au Empire, and the countless conflicts that have shaped the galaxy. Episodes combine historical context, military analysis, political intrigue, religion, technology, and mythology to explain not only what happened, but why these events and ideas matter within the larger Warhammer 40,000 setting.

Designed for longtime fans and newcomers alike, the podcast approaches 40K as a living fictional history filled with competing accounts, ancient legends, unreliable narrators, lost civilizations, and unanswered questions. Discover the origins of legendary warriors, follow galaxy-changing campaigns, examine forbidden technologies, explore the Warp and Webway, and investigate mysteries that even the Imperium cannot fully explain. Rather than reducing the setting to simple summaries or power rankings, each episode seeks to provide accessible, thoughtful context while preserving the scale, tragedy, uncertainty, and atmosphere that make Warhammer 40,000 unique. Visit ImaginedBattlefield.com for more military history and science fiction.

title: Go Slow. Study Deep. Be Transformed.
author: Rebecca — Lyric and Letter Studios
description: Go Slow. Study Deep. Be Transformed. is a Bible study podcast for women who want to move beyond surface-level reading and study Scripture deeply and faithfully. Journey chronologically from Genesis to Revelation as we observe the text, explore its context, trace biblical themes, and see how the whole story points to Christ. Study alongside the Lyric & Letter Companion Study App, where each passage is explored using our complete Study Method. Open your Bible, bring your questions, and let’s study together.

title: Video Implosion
author: Someone's Favorite Productions
description:
It's Friday night at the video store. The sun is just disappearing behind the hills. 

Two people inside browsing as they organically search for and define the perfect double feature together.
 
Through the spontaneous process of debating, remembering, and reacting, conversations naturally emerge about cinema, personal taste, nostalgia, genre, aesthetics, and cultural impact.

The chemistry between the subjects, the randomness of discovery, and the tactile experience of interacting with physical media are the foundation of the series where nothing is picked out ahead of time.
 
The goal is to highlight the shrinking world of video stores and how we interact with them through memories, culture, and good vibes.
 
“Like the Criterion Closet, but messier.” “Like The Cinema Club, but lo-fi.” “Like What’s in My Bag, but looser.” “Like Four Favorites, but less focused on the ‘right’ answers.”
 
This is Video Implosion.

Video Implosion is a joint production of:

Get Super Rad: https://www.instagram.com/get_super_rad/
Antenna Releasing: https://www.antennareleasing.com/
Empowered by Someone's Favorite Productions: https://www.someonesfavoriteproductions.com/network

Welcome to Miles Together!✨️
a podcast about becoming your best self while exploring the world!🌍
Through honest conversations, personal stories, and lessons learned along the way, we'll talk about growth, fear, confidence, travel, and what it really means to build a life that feels like your own.
If you've ever felt like you're behind in life, stuck in a routine, or searching for something more, this is your reminder that you're not alone.

title: Chronic, Not Crazy
author: Leo Mind and Body
description: Chronic, Not Crazy is a podcast hosted by Ava and Maddie, in collaboration with Leo Mind and Body. We talk openly about endometriosis, adenomyosis, and the realities of living with chronic illness—from symptoms and diagnosis to treatment, medical gaslighting, relationships, and everything in between. Through honest conversations, personal stories, and guests who have lived it, we’re creating a space where you feel heard, understood, and less alone. Your symptoms are real. Your story matters. You’re Chronic, Not Crazy.

Als ervaren lokale dakdekker bespreken we veelvoorkomende dakproblemen en leggen we uit hoe u uw dak veilig, duurzaam en in goede conditie houdt. Ever wondered what the Teen Choice Awards smelled like in 2004? What about New York Fashion Week? The pillow menu at the Rosewood Hotel?

Each episode pairs NYC-based fragrance expert Asia Grant with an iconic commentator, creator or cultural obsessive to follow the olfactory trail back in time, unpacking the collective memories, stories and oddly specific notes that make the past feel somehow vividly present.

Each episode digs into museum curation, exhibit design, and the visitor experience — plus the essential question: What's actually worth buying in the gift shop? Season One spotlights museums in the San Francisco Bay Area, including the Walt Disney Family Museum, the deYoung Museum, and the USS Hornet Museum.

We don't have all the answers; we're just two guys working to build better lives and futures by focusing on character, discipline, faith, and the lessons we've learned the hard way. Each week we tackle issues like the evolution of masculinity, what does chivalry mean today, relationships (platonic and otherwise), brotherhood, and things men go through, but don't often discuss.

title: Cat Chat Live - Life Between The Hulls
author: Catamaran Central
description:
Cat Chat Live: Life Between the Hulls is the podcast for anyone passionate about catamarans—sail or power.
In each episode, the team at Catamaran Central discusses the latest topics shaping the multihull world, answers frequently asked questions, shares insights into the catamaran brokerage market, and takes a closer look at a featured make and model.
The conversations are unscripted, unfiltered, and driven by a genuine love of life between the hulls. 
It's simply a couple of catamaran enthusiasts talking about what they know and love best: catamarans.

title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu Official Podcast
author: Lucasfilms, Jon Favreau
description: A two episode series designed to take Star Wars' biggest and newest fans behind the scenes of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, in conjunction with the film's release on Disney+. Shot on the movie's Adelphi Base Bar set, guests include writer-director Jon Favreau, the President of Lucasfilm, Dave Filoni, Academy-Award winning composer Ludwig Göransson and the on-screen stars of the film, Pedro Pascal and Sigourney Weaver. Even Grogu himself swings by, to inject a heavy dose of cuteness into the series as the creative team discusses the ingredients that made this film so special, as both a fresh chapter in Star Wars' remarkable history, and an exciting new page in the Mandalorian and Grogu's own stories.

title: Behind the Meter

description: NRG Energy generates power, but its bet is that the business is no longer the plant — it's the other side of the meter. Behind the Meter reads each NRG quarter from the customer's side of the line: what management promised, what the filings actually say, and what deserves a place on the next committee agenda. Whether you are an industry professional or simply tech-curious, we provide the insights you need to understand how the future is being built. title: New Business Jump Start Show
author: Evan Palmer
description:
• New Business Jump Start Show

  • If you've ever thought about starting your own business, this is the podcast for you. Perhaps you've had a career doing something else and are ready to finally jump into the entrepreneurial waters. Maybe you're looking to build a profitable side project. Or perhaps there's an idea you've had for a long time and you're ready to finally take action. Whatever the situation may be, when people go into business for themselves, there's a LOT to know: accounting, sales, marketing, production, customer service, billing, finance, legal, human resources, etc. In addition to not knowing enough about each aspect, the larger reality is that you don't know what you don't know, and often don't know whom to ask for help. Our podcast guests offer insights into each area of business, helping you to gain knowledge and focus on the most important elements. We'll discuss everything from overcoming common obstacles to selling and promoting yourself and your business or service, and lots more. We want to give you an advantage because we've been there and done that and we want you to learn from our mistakes as well as our successes.

title: Worry About Yourself
author: Lauren Mooney Jones
description:
This podcast was born from the ways God has transformed me and taught me how to stop allowing my circumstances to control my emotions, my choices, and my life. 
We’re going to talk all about how get our lives back by stewarding what we have instead of worrying about what we can’t control. Through scripture, science, and a little bit of tough love, we’re going to help each other grow in our faith, in our relationships, and into the best versions of ourselves - becoming exactly who God created you to be. But in order to do that, you’ve got to do what your momma said and worry about yourself 💅

title: Cafe Crossing Worlds
author: Pavani Govindam
description:
What happens when you cross worlds?
A girl from India who crossed over to the UK, found comfort in cafés, unfamiliar faces and new experiences — and discovered herself along the way.
For anyone crossing worlds, physically, mentally or emotionally, come sit with me.
Wherever you go, you are your own world. ☕️🌍

author: Raymond Kobe
description: Money Wise Decisions helps everyday people handle bills, debt, savings, and surprise expenses without jargon or judgment. Each episode starts with a real-life money problem, explains the numbers step by step, and ends with one small action you can take today. title: Stealing the Moment
author: Katie and Sean
description:
Stealing the Moment is a passionate, baseball-loving conversation between Katie Redmiles and her brother Sean as they explore the launch of the Women’s Professional Baseball League and what it means for the future of the sport. Equal parts sports talk, history, and personal reflection, the show follows their deep love of baseball, their excitement about seeing women finally have a true professional path in the game, and their candid reactions to the league’s inaugural season and the emotional weight of this historic moment.

Be a part of a new sports era and steal this moment!

title: The Drift Den Podcast
author: thedriftdenpod
description:
I wanted to create The Drift Den as a soft-landing place, a space where you can gently unwind, settle your thoughts, and ease your body into rest through guided meditations and bedtime stories.

Living with chronic illness and chronic pain has made sleep a challenge for me, but over the last six years, meditation and soothing nighttime stories have become a lifeline, helping me drift into sleep with more comfort and calm.

I wanted to build a sanctuary for anyone who struggles to fall asleep, wrestles with racing thoughts, or simply needs a moment to exhale. Whether you’re here to relax, to reset, or to drift off completely, this space is for you.

title: The Baton Rouge Parents Podcast

description:
What if the best years of your life haven’t happened yet?
Hosted by lawyer and writer Jacqui Jubb, Never Too Late Club explores how people build extraordinary lives - the choices they make, the risks they take and the moments that change everything. From career and money to relationships, health and bold reinvention, expect remarkable stories, smart advice and big ideas — all with one thing in mind: creating a life you actually want, at any age.
You’re not too late. You haven’t missed your chance. Let’s press play on your dreams.

Inexplicable is a conversational podcast about the strange beliefs, everyday arguments, cultural habits, personal stories, and big questions that shape the way we live. author: Commonwealth Guardians
description:
Michael Makes Sense cuts through the noise of personal finance with clear, practical conversations designed to help you make more confident decisions about your financial future.

Hosted by Michael Widlake, Founder of Commonwealth Guardians, the show tackles the real questions people have about money, retirement, investing, financial planning, risk, and the decisions that can shape the years ahead.

From When will I be able to retire? and Will I run out of money? to Do I really need a financial advisor?, Michael takes complicated financial topics and explains them in a way that is straightforward, approachable, and easy to understand.

You’ll also hear questions from listeners facing the same financial concerns many of us have, along with conversations about what to consider before making some of life’s biggest financial decisions.

Michael Makes Sense
Common Sense Answers in Uncommon Financial Times.

Real questions. Clear answers. Conversations that make sense.

Learn more at MichaelMakesSense.com.

Rare Endocrine Exchange features interviews with leading endocrinologists, researchers, and healthcare professionals discussing the latest advances in rare endocrine disorders. Topics include emerging therapies, clinical research, conference coverage, and practical insights to help improve patient care.

Hosted by Dr. Margarita Ochoa-Maya and produced by CheckRare, Rare Endocrine Exchange connects the endocrine community with the latest science and expert perspectives that can improve clinical care.

title: Magic: The 2013 Pittsburgh Pirates and How To Save Baseball
author: CB Podcasting
description:
Baseball is undergoing an image crisis. Its most beleaguered franchise may hold the blueprint to its salvation.
Join host Casey Bryant in evaluating how the Pittsburgh Pirates died, yet emerged from the Dark Ages of 20 straight losing seasons to orchestrate one of the most remarkable runs in modern baseball history. From Sid Bream to Johnny Cueto's dropped ball, the Pirates' bizarre history reveals MLB's "small market" problem.

title: The Recovery Blueprint: Building Recovery Ecosystems
author: The ARCHway Institute
description:
The Recovery Blueprint: Building Recovery Ecosystems is the official podcast of The ARCHway Institute's national campaign to build, fund, and support recovery ecosystems across the United States. Each episode goes behind the scenes of a five-year movement uniting communities, employers, government leaders, recovery providers, and advocates around one goal: creating connected systems where people in recovery can find lasting pathways to employment, housing, healthcare, and community.

Hosted by Dr. Stephanie Hutter-Thomas, the show talks with the people doing the work — community organizers, state leaders, employers, and recovery providers from Arkansas, Missouri, Ohio, Florida, and beyond — to unpack what it actually takes to move a community from isolated services to a true recovery ecosystem. Listeners get real strategy, real partnerships, and real stories of what's working on the ground, episode by episode, state by state.

This isn't just a campaign. It's a blueprint. And it starts here.

title: Nobody Told Us This - Dr Liz X Special Guests
author: Dr Liz Murray BCA
description:
Nobody Told Us This is the podcast for the conversations life forgot to prepare you for.


Hosted by Dr Liz Murray, an award-winning doctor, author Not Just Painful Periods, speaker, and women’s health advocate.

 

Each episode explores the things we all experience but rarely talk about openly—from relationships, parenthood, grief, identity and careers to women’s health, resilience, neurodiversity, trauma, and everything in between.

 

After spending more than a decade working on the frontline of Emergency Medicine, Liz now dedicates her work to helping people navigate the realities of health and life that so often go unspoken. Her refreshingly honest approach, combined with personal lived experience and professional expertise, has made her a trusted voice for hundreds of thousands of people seeking truth over perfection.

 

Expect remarkable guests, expert insight, practical takeaways, plenty of laughter, and the occasional uncomfortable truth. No filters. No pretending. Just the conversations that leave you thinking…

“Why did nobody tell us this?”


Full video interview and shorts available across Dr Liz's social channels @drlizmurray

Not Just Painful Periods is the debut book by Dr Liz Murray and is available on Amazon, Waterstones and all major booksellers. Published by Octopus Publishing.

She discusses how embracing life's messiness and loving oneself can lead to growth and resilience. 

She will share the core of Heart and Habit, such as, Health, Fitness, Food, Exercise, Marriage, Family, Relationships, Loss, Grief, School, Business, Parenting, Supplements, Peptides, HRT, Getting Older, Starting Over, Habits, Personal Growth...nothing if off the table!!!

She will also share what Heart and Habit means to her, what to expect from the podcast and why she hopes every conversation leaves you feeling happier, more encouraged, and more like yourself.

title: Do Different, Feel Different by Dr. Charles Roberts
author: Dr. Charles Roberts
description:
Do Different. Feel Different. is a series of short, five-minute monologues with Dr. Charles Roberts designed to help you understand why you think, feel, and behave the way you do. Each episode offers one practical insight to quiet the noise, interrupt unhelpful patterns, and help you do different—so you can feel different.

The podcast expands on ideas from Dr. Charles Roberts’ book, Do Different. Feel Different., exploring anxiety, overthinking, emotional regulation, mindfulness, behavioral health, and lasting behavior change. If you’re ready to better understand your mind, break patterns that keep you stuck, and take greater control of how you respond to life, start listening—and discover the book for a deeper dive.

Want to go deeper? Follow Dr. Charles Roberts on Substack at charlesrobertsbli.substack.com for more insights on behavior, mental health, and practical ways to do different and feel different.

title: Life happens, money matters™

# Life Happens. Money Matters.
Life doesn't come with a financial instruction manual. Whether you're starting your career, raising a family, caring for aging parents, preparing for retirement, or facing an unexpected life event, the financial decisions you make can shape what comes next.
Hosted by Adile Williams, founder of American Financial Pathways, this podcast turns everyday financial topics into practical, easy-to-understand conversations. title: The Whole Life Podcast

The Whole Life is a podcast that shares honest conversations about faith, family, and living with purpose. We talk about navigating the many different parts of life while staying grounded in what matters most.

title: I Wish Somebody Told Me
author: Jason Malone
description:
Nobody sat us down and explained how to protect what we build. No one in our family talked about trusts, wills, probate, or what happens to everything we worked for when we are gone. Most of us figured it out too late. Our families paid the price because we never figured it out at all. I Wish Somebody Told Me is the show that fills that gap. Visit fortitudefinancial.co to build your personalized estate plan and take the first step toward protecting everything you have built.

Every episode breaks down estate planning, asset protection, and wealth transfer in plain language. No jargon. No gatekeeping. No assumptions that you already know how this works. Because most of us were never taught. If you own a home, run a business, have children, or have anything worth protecting this show is for you. Topics we cover: how to avoid probate, the difference between a will and a trust, how to fund a trust properly, protecting your business for the next generation, estate planning for blended families, how to transfer wealth without court involvement, and the mistakes that cost families everything they built.

Hosted by Jason Malone, founder of Fortitude Financial. Licensed estate planning advisor with a background in institutional finance and Wall Street. Jason built this practice specifically to give our community access to the same level of planning that wealthy families have used for generations. New episodes every two weeks. Subscribe so you never miss one. This podcast is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal or tax advice. Estate planning services provided by Fortitude Financial.

We focus on what matters, cut out the noise, and get your habits, mindset, and behaviors in total alignment with your vision. Hit subscribe and join us

Bow!

Hansel and Gretel’s Universe

Step beyond the familiar forest and into a world where a classic fairy tale takes on a whole new life.

Hansel and Gretel’s Universe presents modern, imaginative reimaginings of the beloved Hansel and Gretel characters, placing them at the center of new adventures, mysteries, challenges, and discoveries. Each series explores a different chapter of their expanding universe while also introducing new interpretations of the folklore, legends, creatures, and characters connected to the original tale.

From strange encounters and mysterious spirits to monsters, enchanted places, and the secrets of the legendary witch, Hansel and Gretel’s world is constantly growing. Upcoming series will take a deeper look at the infamous Candy House, the lore surrounding the witch, and the stories and characters that have become part of this enduring folklore.

Following each episode, join CJ for a special companion program, Mythology, where the latest adventure is discussed and explored. CJ takes a closer look at the story, characters, folklore, themes, and mysteries behind the episode, giving listeners an opportunity to see the adventure from a whole new perspective.

description:
What began as a federal investigation into one man’s criminal activities gradually revealed something far larger and more troubling — a structured network allegedly combining professional surveillance expertise, corrupted law enforcement access, and organized criminal leadership into an operation that federal investigators say targeted innocent victims across Los Angeles with calculated precision. At its center sits Adam Iza. Around him, a cast of alleged collaborators whose combined capabilities allegedly made the network extraordinarily dangerous.
Adam Iza: From Street Criminal to Alleged Network Leader
--------------------------------------------------------
Adam Iza, who previously operated under the legal name Ahmed Faiq, is not a figure who stumbled accidentally into serious criminality. Carrying prior robbery convictions in California and reported connections to ISIS linked individuals, Iza allegedly built a deliberate and sophisticated criminal structure designed to sustain long term operations while maintaining maximum insulation from law enforcement detection. That insulation allegedly came from recruiting professionals and insiders whose legitimate standing gave the network cover that pure criminal actors could never manufacture independently. Iza has since entered a guilty plea in the California criminal case, legally confirming his central role in the alleged conspiracy.
Ken Childs: The Licensed Investigator Who Allegedly Crossed Every Line
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Among the most troubling figures named in connection with the Iza investigation is *Ken Childs* ( https://kenchilds4.wordpress.com/2026/05/09/explosive-allegations-surrounding-ken-childs/ ) , founder of Paramount Investigative Services Inc. A licensed California private investigator with over two decades of professional experience and a polished public profile built through television appearances and industry recognition, Childs represented exactly the kind of credentialed professional whose participation could give a criminal network something invaluable — respectability.
Investigators allege that Childs provided systematic surveillance support on individuals targeted by the network prior to violent criminal attacks being carried out against them. His alleged function was operational and deliberate — gathering ground level intelligence on victims, mapping their movements, and feeding that information directly to criminal leadership. Rather than serving the cause of justice his license represented, Childs allegedly placed his professional capabilities entirely at the disposal of organized crime.
Corrupt Deputies: Institutional Betrayal at Its Deepest
-------------------------------------------------------
The investigation’s most institutionally damaging revelations involve the alleged recruitment of Los Angeles Sheriff’s Department personnel into the criminal network. Detective Eric Chase Saavedra, who has entered a guilty plea confirming his participation, former deputy Richard Dudgeon, a currently suspended deputy sharing his name, and suspended deputies Christopher Quintero and his brother Michael Quintero are all identified in connection with the alleged conspiracy.
What these insiders allegedly contributed was irreplaceable. Sensitive law enforcement databases containing personal records, address histories, vehicle registration data, and real time location information allegedly flowed through compromised channels directly into criminal hands. The alleged corruption of active and former law enforcement personnel transformed an already dangerous criminal network into something approaching a private intelligence operation — one with institutional reach that no legitimate private actor should ever possess.
The Surveillance Network: Technology Turned Against the Innocent
----------------------------------------------------------------
The technical infrastructure allegedly deployed against victims reflected sophisticated operational planning. StingRay cell-site simulators reportedly intercepted phone data and exposed precise user locations. Tower dump requests reconstructed detailed movement patterns across extended timeframes. DMV database queries unlocked personal identification records on demand. Falsified warrant affidavits allegedly deceived judges into authorizing surveillance access that should never have been granted — corrupting the judicial oversight process itself and turning constitutional protections into hollow formalities against a network that knew exactly how to circumvent them.
Guilty Pleas and Unanswered Questions
-------------------------------------
The legal proceedings connected to the Iza investigation have already produced significant consequences. With Iza himself, Iris Au, and Eric Chase Saavedra all having entered guilty pleas, the documented core of the alleged conspiracy carries substantial court confirmation. Each guilty plea adds another layer of legal weight to the broader picture federal investigators have assembled — and raises increasingly pointed questions about full accountability for every individual whose alleged participation has been identified in connection with the network.
Conclusion: An Investigation With More to Reveal
------------------------------------------------
The Adam Iza investigation is not a closed chapter. It is an ongoing legal and institutional reckoning whose full dimensions may not yet be completely understood. What is already established through court proceedings is that a sophisticated criminal network allegedly operated across Los Angeles with professional cover, institutional backing, and technological capabilities that made its victims essentially defenseless. As federal scrutiny continues and legal proceedings develop, the complete truth of what allegedly occurred — and who bears full responsibility for it — remains to be told.

What happens when we slow down, step outside, and have a real conversation?

Hosted by photographer and creator Humble Lyons, each episode takes the conversation outdoors. No cameras. No lights. No studio distractions. Just two people walking, talking, listening, and allowing nature to become part of the experience.

Conversations explore their personal stories, their work, what nature has taught them, and the different ways they have learned to interact with the world around them.
Each episode also includes a moment of intentional silence, giving both the guest and listener a chance to stop talking, listen, reflect, and simply experience the environment.
And nature does not have to mean hiking a mountain or disappearing into the wilderness. It can be walking through a park, sitting beside the water, spending time on your patio, watching the stars, tending to a plant, or simply stepping outside for a little fresh air.
The goal is simple: have great conversations in nature, about nature, while discovering practical and sometimes unexpected ways nature can become part of our everyday lives.
This podcast shares personal experiences, ideas, and perspectives and is not intended to provide medical advice.
Put on your headphones and come take a walk with us.

title: Murder Rounds: True Crime from Inside Medicine
author: NURSING.com
description:
very hospital runs on trust. These are the cases where that trust was the weapon.
Murder Rounds is a true crime podcast about healthcare's most disturbing killers — the nurses and doctors who murdered the patients they were meant to protect — told by the people who actually work in those buildings.
Each episode goes past the headlines to the part nobody covers: how they got away with it for so long. The neutral reference. The report filed into a channel designed to keep it invisible. The records destroyed under subpoena. In case after case, the institution's first instinct was to protect itself.
Every episode ends with The Chart Review — a segment where we set the story aside and ask what actually changed. What safeguards exist now. What a clinician should do today if they see something. What the system learned, and what it didn't.
Researched, written, and reviewed by real nurses. Every claim sourced to court records, inquiry reports, and contemporaneous journalism — not true-crime folklore. Where the evidence is disputed, we say so.
From NURSING.com, trusted by more than a million nursing students and clinicians.
New episodes weekly.

title: Soul Portals: Exploring Psychospiritual Horizons

description: An hour’s glimpse into the visions of teachers and guides who inspire others to live in a bigger story of soul purpose . Many individuals seeking coaching, counselling, psychotherapy, or spiritual guidance have a feeling that life holds more potential than their current circumstances suggest. Aside from the basics of maintaining sanity and well-being in the 21st century, we can envision a better world and more personal fulfillment. Yet amidst the tumult of modern life, where are the examples of humanity's best qualities? In this podcast series, Cedric Speyer and DeeAnna Nagel engage in conversations with psychospiritual trailblazers, amplifying their voices of wisdom and exploring their unique perspectives on human wholeness. Through their sacred journeys and professional endeavors, these individuals are ‘portals’ through which we see wider vistas of the soul journey. While their names might not grace network news or mainstream podcasts, their insights introduce invaluable aspects of ‘soul work’.  Soul work (and play) transcends the mere amalgamation of mental and emotional well-being, optimum personality traits, and worldly life skills. It delves deeper, calling forth spiritual capacities at the growing edge of our life's purpose. It allows individual talents and personal pathways to converge with what the world needs. It empowers us to heed the inner call, that paradoxically reaches beyond ourselves. Join us monthly for an inspiring hour with those contributing to our personal and collective growth in profound ways.  Your Soul Portals hosts: Cedric M. Speyer , M.A., M.Ed., RP, is an author, Registered Psychotherapist, and presently a mentor to coaches, counsellors, and therapists. He pioneered E-counselling in Canada, overseeing 100K online cases before establishing InnerView Guidance International (IGI). The vision of IGI brings together the historically separate domains of mental health and spiritual awareness in a new synthesis for the helping professions. https://www.innerviewguidance.com/ DeeAnna Merz Nagel , D.Th., LPC, LMHC, BCC, is a licensed psychotherapist and board-certified coach. DeeAnna teaches the ethical integration of alternative and psychospiritual approaches for coaches and therapists. She holds several certifications in the healing arts including Reiki and aromatherapy. DeeAnna’s doctoral studies focused on multifaith spiritual direction. https://deeannamerznagel.com/ Sponsored by Onlinevents https://www.onlinevents.co.uk/

title: Chief Change Officer™
author: Vince Chan
description:
Change is already working on you. Could you make it work for you?


Chief Change Officer™ is a podcast for people who want to turn change into a breakthrough. It is for those reshaping a career, redirecting an organization, or rebuilding a life.


The show is hosted by Vince Chan, whose first lesson in change came at age four, after a severe arm injury led to surgery, hospitalization, and a long recovery. Since adolescence, she has lived through 20 major transformations across countries, careers, and crises. Before launching the podcast, she spent three decades in global finance and economics, from central banking and credit markets to billion-dollar institutional capital.


That experience taught her that change is never only personal. Markets shift. Institutions decide. Circumstances expand or narrow what people believe is possible. Talent matters, but so do context, timing, and power.


Vince brings together rare minds, black sheep, breakthrough builders, and unconventional champions from around the world. They include scholars who have spent decades studying people and institutions, executives who have carried responsibility through uncertainty, and leaders whose most valuable knowledge was earned beyond the clean lines of a textbook.


Together, they bring what Vince calls hard-earned human intelligence: judgment shaped by consequence and tested by time, trial, and revision.


They do not offer polished success stories or textbook formulas. They reveal what helped when plans collapsed, careers broke open, or life demanded a new direction.


Each conversation turns hard-earned human intelligence into practical judgment: how to understand what is changing, make stronger decisions, and move forward without losing yourself.


Chief Change Officer™ extends Vince’s work beyond markets and institutions into the human side of power and change. How people understand themselves, navigate their environment, and reclaim agency when the old rules no longer hold.


A Global Top 1% podcast and US #1 Careers show, Chief Change Officer™ is built for people who do not want merely to endure change. They want to understand it, use it, and turn it into a breakthrough.


Life is change. The question is whether change works on you, or you learn to make it work for you.

title: The POUR Collective podcast
author: Rasheité Calhoun
description: A place for worshippers and ministry leaders to learn to pour from the overflow and avoid burnout. You were never meant to be empty. Come and get your fill.

title: Pastoral Problems
author: Philip Stanley
description:
Pastoral Problems is where pastors Phil Stanley and Justin Wright talk honestly about ministry—the meaningful, the messy, and the completely ridiculous. Expect real conversations about church leadership, preaching, discipleship, culture, and pastor life, mixed with humor, wild church stories, and plenty of rabbit trails.
Pastoral problems are inevitable. Becoming one is optional.

title: The Dark Side Of Wealth
author: Dorian Slate
description: The Dark Side of Wealth is a cinematic storytelling podcast that takes real life stories involving money, ambition, and power and tells them like movies. Every episode pulls the listener inside a world most people only read headlines about - the rise, the obsession, the fall, and the uncomfortable truth underneath it all.

title: VOICES OF GREYSTONES
author: High Tide Studios
description:
Every town has its stories. Some are well known. Most are quietly carried by the people who live there.


Voices of Greystones is a community podcast celebrating the people, memories and moments that make one of Ireland's most remarkable coastal towns unique.


From lifelong locals and newcomers to business owners, artists, volunteers and everyday people with extraordinary experiences, every conversation is a chance to capture a piece of Greystones that might otherwise be lost to time.


Some stories will make you laugh. Others may move you or inspire you. Together, they create a lasting record of the people who make this community what it is.

Recorded at High Tide Studios in the heart of Greystones, every episode begins with a simple coffee and a chat before becoming an honest conversation, preserved for future generations.


Everyone in this town has a story. Some just haven't been asked yet.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: A Simple and Purposeful Home
author: Devon Norris
description:
Purpose needs breathing room.
Home is so much bigger, richer, and simpler than we have been told.
A Simple and Purposeful Home is for the mom who is searching for meaning but exhausted by the world's complicated, anxious solutions — the one who scrolls Instagram and Pinterest and TikTok, overwhelmed and defeated.
I'm Devon — pediatric cardiac nurse turned homeschool mom, grain miller, healthy home consultant, & small business owner. Not here to tell you what to do or make you feel behind. Just honest conversation about what I'm trying, and freedom to take what works for your family.

title: Let's Talk Email
author: Steven Sayo & Jay Oram
description: Welcome to Let's Talk Email, the podcast that dives deep into the world of email. Join hosts Jay Oram and Steven Sayo as they explore everything from the intricacies of email design and coding to the latest platforms, accessibility best practices, and upcoming industry events. Whether you're a seasoned email developer, a marketer looking to boost your campaigns, or simply curious about the technology behind your inbox, Let's Talk Email is your essential guide to navigating the ever-evolving landscape of digital communication. Tune in for expert insights, lively discussions, and a healthy dose of email geekery.

title: The sanderstamorie6’s Podcast
author: sanderstamorie6
description:
CNA Real Talk is the podcast for Certified Nursing Assistants who want to grow their skills, confidence, and professionalism. Hosted by an experienced CNA, each episode teaches one practical lesson you can use on your very next shift. Through real stories, real workplace situations, and actionable advice, you’ll learn better communication, teamwork, resident care, professionalism, safety, and career success. Whether you’re a new CNA or a seasoned caregiver, this podcast will help you provide exceptional care and become the kind of CNA residents, families, and employers remember.
Real Stories. Real Advice. Real Impact.

title: The Blue Centre Halves Podcast
author: The Blue Centre Halves
description: Two bang average footballers at a bang average standard, with the hope of having a slightly better than average podcast.

title: The Healer Within
author: Tracy Fance
description:
Have you ever asked yourself why this keeps happening?
The same relationship. The symptom nobody can explain. The pattern you can't break. The feeling life is stuck on repeat.
The Healer Within is for the woman who's done the therapy, read the books, tried everything, and still can't get to the root of it.
I'm Tracy Fance. For over sixteen years I've helped women find the real root of what's driving their health, their relationships and their repeating patterns.
One idea. One story. 15-20 minutes. Raw and honest.
The healer is already within you. This podcast helps you find her.

title: Kiltman’s Kitchen
author: Keith “Kiltman” Robinson
description:
Now let’s get this clear right from the start - I’m not a professional cook by any stretch of the imagination, nor do I have any formal culinary qualifications.
This doesn’t stop me from chucking a few ingredients together to try to create something that tastes great, and in most cases, is kinda healthy. 
Join me for some culinary shenanigans..

title: Practical Insights
author: Mara Kaufman
description: Practical Insights is for people if who are sick of dating and want a serious committed “in-love” relationship. You’ll gain the tools to understand yourself and your relationships more deeply, so you can create the relationship you actually want. Each episode explores the complicated human stuff underneath relationships and turns it into practical insights you can use. Mara’s practical, actionable perspective helps you understand your patterns, your needs, and what you bring to a relationship. You’ll learn how to move toward a long-lasting, committed relationship where you can be fully yourself, have amazing chemistry, want the same kind of life together, get through the rough patches and enjoy each other. Mara took about 5-7 different programs to improve her relationships when she was single, had years of therapy, had multiple serious-committed relationships where they were in love , ending with her husband. And had at least 3 guys propose....seriously, not joking around.

title: The Faith We Share Podcast
author: The Faith We Share Podcast
description: The Faith We Share is a mother-and-daughter journey through God’s Word, reading the Bible together one chapter at a time and sharing honest thoughts, questions and discoveries along the way. Following a chronological reading plan, we explore scripture in a warm, family-friendly way, learning together what God’s Word has to teach us. Whether you’re a parent listening with your child or simply looking for a gentle way for them to explore the Bible, we hope you’ll feel encouraged, inspired and reminded that faith is something beautiful to share.

title: Everything’s Fine (But It’s Not)
author: Ebony In-depth
description: Everything’s Fine (But It’s Not) is a raw, funny, and emotionally honest podcast about the invisible weight people carry while trying to hold life together. Through real conversations about motherhood, relationships, family struggles, healing, emotional burnout, identity, and everyday survival, therapist and mom Ebony gives language to experiences many silently live through. Whether it looks like over-functioning, shutting down, avoiding, overthinking, or overplanning what’s next, this podcast is for the people everyone depends on — often while struggling more than anyone realizes.

title: A Pocket Full of Jewels
author: Julie Marie
description:
Life isn’t always sparkly. Sometimes it’s messy, heavy, confusing, and downright hard—but even in the hardest moments, there are little pieces of beauty worth finding.
Welcome to *A Pocket Full of Jewels* , a podcast hosted by Julie where we talk about real life, real feelings, personal growth, relationships, motherhood, starting over, finding yourself, and those moments when you need a little reminder that you’re stronger than you think.
This isn’t a podcast about having everything figured out. It’s about being honest about the journey—the good days, the bad days, the lessons, the laughter, and the moments that shape who we become.
Think of each episode as a little jewel to put in your pocket and carry with you: a thought, a story, a laugh, or a reminder that might be exactly what you needed to hear that day.
Because sometimes, when life feels heavy, *you just have to find your sparkle again.* ✨💎
Come sit with me, grab your coffee, and let’s find the jewels hidden in everyday life.
*A Pocket Full of Jewels — because there’s always a little sparkle somewhere.*

title: be-teachable
author: Larisa
description:
Life doesn't come with a map. 
But every person we meet leaves behind clues, lessons, and experiences that can help us navigate our own path.
In my podcast, I sit down with leaders, creators, entrepreneurs, and innovators to uncover what they've learned along the way: the successes, the failures, and the decisions that shaped their journey.
Because the goal isn't to follow someone else's map exactly. It's to learn from it, create our own path, and leave a clearer map behind for others.
I'm Larisa, and this is be-teachable.

title: Excellence Becoming
author: K. Joia Houheneka
description: You can build a successful business and still feel that your most important work is ahead of you.  Excellence Becoming is a podcast for entrepreneurs and creators who have already built good lives, but want greater excellence and fresh perspective for what they’re becoming.  Hosted by entrepreneur, coach, publisher, and researcher of human flourishing K. Joia Houheneka, the show explores how excellence is actually formed over a lifetime.  Through conversations with entrepreneurs, creators, and other exemplars, Excellence Becoming goes beneath polished success stories to uncover the formative experiences that shape a life: failures that changed everything, tensions that demanded growth, mistakes that became turning points, and moments of reinvention that transformed success into something deeper.  Because excellence is not a destination.  It is a process of becoming.  Produced by The Worthy Excellence Institute and Gold Standards Media, this podcast is part of a larger exploration of human excellence, self-actualization, entrepreneurship, philosophy, and the conditions that allow human beings to flourish.  If you are building a business in alignment with a worthwhile life, if you believe entrepreneurship can be an expression of who you are rather than simply a way to earn a living, and if you are seeking greater integration between mission, prosperity, contribution, beauty, and legacy, you will feel at home here.  As our gift to listeners, we invite you to receive a complimentary issue of Gold Standards Magazine, where we celebrate the entrepreneurs, creators, and institutions whose work embodies excellence.  Visit www.worthyexcellence.com to explore the wider project.  Claim your complimentary issue at www.goldstandardsmagazine.com.

title: Freedonomix
author: Independent Wealth Partners
description:
Freedonomix is a podcast about more than just money—it's about people, purpose, and the stories that shape our lives. Powered by Independent Wealth Partners, this show is for anyone who believes that true financial freedom is about living the life you want, not just the returns you get.
At Freedonomix, we dive into two key areas, Practical Financial Wisdom (tax, investing, wealth strategies etc.) as well as Inspiring Life Stories from friends and clients . 
Whether you're here for the financial insights, the personal stories, or a bit of both, we're glad you've joined us.
Lets get started.

title: Mersey Views
author: Liverpool City Council
description:
Mersey Views is Liverpool City Council's monthly podcast: an honest, plainspoken conversation between the city and the people who run it.

Each episode, council leader Liam Robinson and Dylan Evans take one subject that matters to Liverpool and really get into it, alongside the people living and leading the work. Expect a straight-talking briefing from the leader, a deep dive with guests who know their subject inside out, and Your City, Your Questions, where residents put their questions directly to the leader with no script and no dodging.

This isn't a council broadcast. It's warm, accountable, and confident enough to name what isn't working. From becoming an anti-racist city to backing the next generation, Mersey Views is where Liverpool's real conversations happen.

title: Business Behind the Story
author: Lucas
description:
Business Behind the Story is a documentary podcast about how companies really work — the decisions, strategies, money, competition, and people behind the businesses we know.
Each episode investigates a real company, founder, industry, product, rivalry, collapse, or turnaround. We look beyond headlines and corporate mythology to understand how the business actually made money, what gave it an advantage, which decisions changed its trajectory, and what happened when reality stopped matching the plan.
From technology giants and global brands to startups, retailers, airlines, manufacturers, and spectacular corporate failures, Business Behind the Story explores the forces that build companies — and sometimes destroy them.
Because behind every business is a story about ambition, incentives, timing, capital, competition, and human decisions.

title: Walk That Walk - A Christian Podcast
author: Brother Andrew
description:
Walk That Walk is a Christian podcast focused on taking faith beyond words and putting it into action. Through honest discussions, scripture-grounded encouragement, and real-life perspectives, we explore what it truly means to follow Jesus in today’s world.
Hit Follow to join the community and step into a stronger, purpose-filled walk with Christ every week.

title: The Fight Plan with Kurtis Gabriel
author: Kurtis Gabriel
description: The Fight Plan is a raw, real, and unfiltered podcast hosted by former AHL/NHL fighter Kurtis Gabriel. Kurtis and his guests explore fights on the ice and in sports—and how they relate to the battles we all face: mental and physical health, relationships, life circumstances, and world events. Guests are met where they are on their journey, and we can each find ourselves in their stories. After every conversation, Kurtis is joined by his dear friend Ben Meyers, a mental health coach with a decade of experience, for "After The Bell" to unpack what came up.

title: Inspired by a Greater Purpose
author: Sis Richards
description:
Welcome to Inspired by a Greater Purpose—a podcast for Young Women Seeking Jesus Christ. Where the world doesn’t define who you are.
This is a place where we can come together as beloved daughters of Heavenly Parents to talk about things that truly matter. Here, you can feel God’s love for you, find Jesus Christ and get excited about being a daughter of God. 

Remember who you are and whose you are. Stay inspired—because you were created for a greater purpose.

title: Human Trials Live
author: with Koots
description:
Human Trials Live is currently planned as a four-episode podcast exploring the connection between our systems and our health. Following my own experiences, we will explore root causes and effects of illness, as well as solutions and positive outcomes.
The objective is simple: question, research, connect—and empower people with information so they can make informed decisions for their families and their communities.
Awareness. Truth. Action.

title: Lens Republic
author: Monique Pizzica and Amanda Starkey
description: Lens Republic is a Melbourne-based photography and videography podcast exploring the creative and business sides of visual storytelling. Hosted by Monique Pizzica and Amanda Starkey who live and breathe the industry, each episode features honest conversations about gear, technique, client work, creative challenges, and the realities of building a career behind the camera. Whether you're just starting out or have years of experience, Lens Republic is a place to learn, be inspired, and connect with the photography community.

title: Generations at the Altar
author: Titus and Vonia Broom
description:
Generations at the Altar is a place for truth, transformation, and Spirit-led teaching. Hosted by Titus and Vonia Broom, we’re building conversations that strengthen faith and understanding.
Generations at the Altar Nights is under the umbrella of Generations at the Altar. We interview those that are in the marketplace about faith and community.

title: Different Chapters
author: Naomi Hartl and Emily Johb
description: Life has a way of taking each of us through different chapters. Different Chapters is a podcast hosted by two sisters navigating very different seasons of life. Through honest conversations about relationships, family, personal growth, healing, identity, and everything in between, we explore what it means to keep becoming. Without pretending to have all the answers. We believe you don't have to be in the same chapter to walk alongside someone. Wherever life has taken you, whatever chapter you find yourself in, we're so glad you're here. Let's turn the page together.

title: RANCH-O-RADIO
author: Uone
description: Welcome to Ranch-O-Radio, the sonic campfire of Australian electronic artist Uone. Expect deep grooves, psychedelic journeys, musical discoveries and stories from the road recorded wherever the journey happens to take us.

title: Building Change: An OAWA Podcast
author: Office to Advance Women Apprentices
description: Building Change is a podcast from the Office to Advance Women Apprentices (OAWA), featuring conversations with industry leaders, employers, educators, and tradeswomen helping shape the future of skilled trades in Newfoundland and Labrador. Through honest discussion and lived experience, the series explores career pathways, workplace culture, mentorship, challenges, and opportunities in the trades. While the conversations are often viewed through the lens of women in trades, many of the themes are universal, offering valuable insight to anyone interested in the industry.

title: The Community Sofa

description: Welcome to The Community Sofa, the podcast bringing together the people, organisations and stories that make our community stronger. Hosted by Courtney Hillman and Debs Sheldon from Right at Home Salisbury & Andover, each episode features relaxed conversations with local charities, healthcare professionals, community groups and experts, helping people discover the support available across Salisbury, Andover and the surrounding villages. Because every great community starts with a conversation.

title: BSCP Trailblazers
author: Biomedical Science Careers Program
description:
BSCP's Trailblazers is a podcast series created by and for the Biomedical Science Careers Program Alumni Network to grow, learn from, and connect with each other as we drive meaningful change in our fields. Through candid conversations with alumni, participants, and partners across all ages and stages of their careers, this series aims to showcase diverse career paths, share lessons learned and leadership insight, and highlight the power of community and long-term professional relationships.
This series is a production of BSCP in Boston, Massachusetts.  Founded in 1991 at Harvard Medical School by Dr. Joan Reede, BSCP began on a local scale and attracted students from Massachusetts and across New England. Today, our reach is national, with representation from all 50 states, Washington, DC, Puerto Rico, and beyond.  For more information go to bscp.org.
Trailblazers is hosted by Jordie Kamuene, PhD, and produced by Jill Ruby.   
The series launches Sept. 1, 2026.  Subscribe to our show wherever you listen to your podcasts.

title: Beyond Plastic: where science meets consciousness
author: Dr. Elie Haddad
description:
"Beyond Plastic: where science meets consciousness" is a journey into the science of living well and the wisdom of living deeply.

Hosted by cardiologist, author, and TEDx speaker Dr. Elie Haddad, the podcast explores the intersection of modern medicine, environmental health, longevity, consciousness, and the deeper questions that shape the way we live.

Drawing from decades in medicine and a lifelong curiosity about the human experience, Dr. Elie moves beyond symptoms and diagnoses to explore the connections between our bodies, our environment, our minds, and our inner lives. Through science, storytelling, and reflection, each series invites us to question what we take for granted, understand the forces shaping our health, and make more conscious choices for ourselves and the world around us.

The journey begins with The Plastic Age, a series tracing the extraordinary rise of plastic from a revolutionary invention to one of the defining materials of our civilization. We’ll explore how it reshaped the way we live, how micro- and nanoplastics found their way into our environment and our bodies, what emerging science is revealing about their impact on human health, and what we can realistically do about it.

Future series will venture into longevity, wellness, consciousness, resilience, purpose, and the evolving science and wisdom of what it means to live a healthier, more meaningful life.

Because living well is about more than adding years to our lives. It is about bringing more life into our years.

title: The Dick & Paul Show
author: Dick Costolo and Paul Kedrosky
description: Two of the sharpest minds in tech, Dick Costolo and Paul Kedrosky, pull back the curtain on AI, startups, and the future that’s rushing toward us. With insider access, fascinating guests, and a healthy dose of irreverence, they’ll make you laugh while they explain how the world might end (and how we might still save it).

title: Coyle CHAOS ⚜️🌴 PODCAST 🎙️ x Brandon Coyle
author: Brandon Coyle
description:
Welcome to the Coyle CHAOS ⚜️🌴 PODCAST 🎙️ x Brandon Coyle, where New Orleans ⚜️ roots meets Beverly Hills 🌴 dreams.
Join Brandon Coyle, husband, dad of three (including twins), professional attention seeker, anxious overthinker, and a guy who always has a story, for unfiltered conversations about family, fatherhood, pop culture, celebrities, business, travel, life, and whatever rabbit hole comes next.

Chocolate, business, nostalgia and the stories behind the bar. 
The Chocolate Man talks to chocolatiers, cocoa farmers, historians, former confectionery workers and fascinating guests, while sharing the journey of building Salahuddin Dates and trying to create a new British chocolate company. 
Expect forgotten favourites, taste tests, chocolate history, new product ideas, business highs and lows, and plenty of proper chocolate talk.

title: Built to Sway
author: The Low-Key Visionary™
description:
The loudest person in the room is usually running a deficit of real authority. But the quietest person is often running an asset deficit—keeping their decades of genius completely undocumented.
If you are an introverted, reserved, or neurodivergent leader, you’ve likely been told that to build an impactful brand, you have to play the loud, performative games of the internet personality economy. You’ve been forced to choose between two exhausting extremes: screaming for attention or staying completely invisible.
Built to Sway is the alternative to the noise.

title: The Corporate Atlas
author: Subhash
description: The Corporate Atlas is a premium business documentary podcast that explores the complete stories behind the world's most influential companies, visionary founders, global brands, and market leaders. Every episode uncovers business strategies, corporate history, leadership decisions, stock market journeys, financial insights, mergers, acquisitions, innovation, and the lessons behind billion-dollar companies. From Apple and Tata to NVIDIA, Amazon, Microsoft, Tesla, PayPal, and more, The Corporate Atlas helps you understand how great companies are built and how they changed the world.

title: We Don't Talk About That Podcast
author: Linda Coogan Byrne
description:
We Don't Talk About That is a bold new podcast exploring the conversations society often avoids but desperately needs to have.


Hosted by award-winning campaigner, researcher and author Linda Coogan Byrne alongside Season One special guest co-hosts Ndidi O and Sangeeta Kalsi, the podcast brings together survivors, activists, academics, artists, industry leaders and changemakers for honest, unfiltered discussions about power, inequality, culture, trauma, resilience and social change.


From violence against women and girls, gender inequality and workplace culture to music, media, politics, identity and the stories that shape our lives, no subject is off limits.


Each episode creates space for the voices too often left out of mainstream conversations, combining lived experience, expert insight and challenging dialogue with compassion, humour and curiosity.


At a time when so many important issues are reduced to headlines and soundbites, We Don't Talk About That goes deeper.

Because the conversations we avoid are often the ones we need most.


Now available across all major podcast platforms.


Brought to you by Why Not Her? and The Industry Review


Season One features "Call Me Queen" by guest co-host Ndidi O, used with permission, as the podcast's opening and closing theme music.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Courageously Caitlin
author: Caitlin Sheets
description: Courageously Caitlin is a podcast where faith meets real life. Join me as we chat about Jesus, the hilltops and valleys, finding hope and cultivating joy in the midst of our everyday! Whether you are new to your faith, navigating uncertainty, or needing encouragement, this podcast is here to remind you that you aren’t alone & that God is for you! Together, we will dive into the deep sharing scripture, testimonies and explore what it means to live courageously with Jesus at the center. Let’s pursue the life God has called us to live - one conversation at a time. Welcome my beautiful friend! 🩷

title: Insurance Traps & Pitfalls
author: David Scheidemantle
description: Insurance Traps & Pitfalls makes smart policyholders smarter. Host David Scheidemantle of Scheidemantle Law Group draws on years of experience in the coverage trenches to deliver engaging discussions on what insurance companies are up to and how policyholders & businesses can protect themselves, while decoding insurance jargon when insurers deny.

title: Pressure
author: Gregory van der Wiel
description: Behind every great career is a person you’ve never truly met. On Pressure, Gregory van der Wiel sits down with people who reached the top of their field to talk about what success really costs: the pressure, fear, sacrifice, setbacks and identity behind the performance. These are not traditional interviews. They are honest conversations shaped by someone who lived it himself, from Ajax and PSG to the 2010 World Cup Final, and the difficult years that followed. This is the side of success that never makes the broadcast.

title: Breaking the Mould
author: katherinenowill
description:
Breaking the Mould is the podcast exploring the future of the plastics and manufacturing industries through the people driving change.

Each episode features conversations with industry leaders, manufacturers, educators, policymakers, training providers, innovators and emerging talent, discussing the issues shaping modern manufacturing - from injection moulding, automation and sustainability to skills, apprenticeships, leadership, education and workforce development.

Whether you're a manufacturer, engineer, recruiter, educator, student or simply interested in how British industry is evolving, Breaking the Mould offers practical insights, fresh perspectives and inspiring stories from across the sector.

Discover how innovation, collaboration and investment in people are helping to build a stronger, more sustainable and more skilled manufacturing future.

title: The Turquoise Witness
author: Catherine
description:
We are clear about the need for racial healing which will continue to be a part of
our conversations, but we clearly see the necessity for enlarging that conversation
to explore planetary healing which includes race, but many other areas as well. We cannot afford to ignore environmental issues and challenges such as climate change, food deserts, homelessness, and loneliness, which the Surgeon General has declared to be at a pandemic level. We will ensure that all of our efforts are inclusive of the race, gender, class, age, and physical ability narratives that need to be seriously interrogated in our culture. 
Our selected guests will represent a very diverse demographic in terms of race, age, and stage of life. We know that the more we engage across as many barriers as possible, the more opportunities are created for true sustainable healing to occur.

Welcome to the Horror Show is a series about facing the fears we usually hide from: rejection, failure, intimacy, and losing control. Each message explores how fear can keep us from honesty, healing, deep relationships, and the life God is calling us into. But this series is not about fear winning. It is about learning to bring those fears into the light, trust the perfect love of Jesus, and take the next brave step toward freedom.
This series contains occasional minor audio glitches from a hardware issue we later discovered. The message remains understandable, so we’re making it available.

We’re Kristina and Gary—married for more than 23 years and living a life that definitely didn’t follow the plan.
This is a podcast about marriage, family, caregiving, memoirs, mishaps, ridiculous stories, hard seasons, lots of laughter, and finding the good stuff somewhere in the middle of all of it.

Marriage. Memoirs. Mishaps. And everything in between.

title: Big Hair Walking
author: Stefanie Cabaniss
description:
The Big Hair Walking: Christian Health Podcast for Women Over 40 | Midlife Strength, Faith & Healthy Aging
For every Christian woman over 40 who’s ever thought...
”I didn’t know it would be like this.”
Life has a way of asking more of us than we expected.
And we have a way of carrying more than we’ve been asked.
If you remember big hair, Walkmans, and walking just because it felt good, you’re in the right place.
The Big Hair Walking Podcast is a Christian podcast for women navigating midlife, menopause, healthy aging, grief, caregiving, changing health, and the everyday challenges of the second half of life.
Hosted by Stef Cabaniss, MA, MPH—health coach, public health professional, and fellow traveler—each episode explores practical ways to build strength, health, and hope through walking, strength training, healthy habits, faith, and evidence-based health coaching.
Whether you’re looking for encouragement, healthier habits, more energy, greater resilience, or a deeper faith, you’ll find honest conversations that help you keep walking through whatever life brings.
This podcast is for Christian women, women over 40, and any woman who’s lived enough life to know it rarely goes according to our plans—but still believes there’s more life ahead.
No pressure.
No striving.
No pretending.
Just one small step at a time—because the smallest steps often result in the biggest changes.
If you’re ready to live stronger in the second half, welcome.
You’re not done.
Not yet.

title: What's Your Passion?
author: Caleb Ervin
description: Welcome to What's Your Passion? Podcast. When I started this show I was 25 years old still struggling to understand my purpose here on earth. You go to work, you come home to eat, you go to bed, and repeat. This show was the forethought to get ahead of that and begin to explore with numerous guests about what their passion is, in a world where everyone is driven by passion or they have no drive at all. This is to explore the deeper critical theory about life in general. We welcome all in this safe space to think how you think, and believe how you believe.

Through psychology, human behavior, Jewish thought, relationships, leadership, and personal growth, Rivkie asks why people resist change and repeat familiar patterns. With warmth and curiosity, this podcast looks beneath the surface at identity, belonging, fear, and hope. For educators, leaders, parents, and anyone trying to understand people more deeply, People Don’t offers a way to make sense of behavior and meaningful change. People don’t need to be simplified. title: Homeland Journey
author: Stewart Muir
description:
Homeland Journey is a documentary interview series from Resource Works that travels into the territories of Indigenous nations across western Canada to let their own leaders tell their own stories.

Each episode is a sit-down conversation, filmed on the land it's about, with hereditary chiefs, elected leaders, and community members who are working to revive their languages and cultures while building real economic self-determination for their people — through forestry, energy, mining, and other resource partnerships that are made on their own terms.

Homeland Journey doesn't come at these conversations as outsiders explaining a community from a distance. It sits down, listens, and lets the people who carry the names, the laws, and the responsibility for their territories speak for themselves — about governance and hereditary law, about the land and what it means to them, about the hard history that got their nations here, and about what self-determination looks like when it's built by the community itself rather than handed to it.

Since launching in 2019, Homeland Journey has featured leaders from nations across British Columbia, and the series continues to expand its reach into new communities across western Canada, one conversation at a time.

New episodes and the full archive are available at resourceworks.com/homelandjourney and on the Homeland Journey YouTube channel.

Homeland Journey is produced by Resource Works.

description: Alexandra Wyman was faced with immense grief when her husband died by suicide in 2020, instantly leaving her a widow and single mom. Since then, she has been finding ways to work through her grief, navigate parenthood and take steps to finding joy again. Join Alexandra on her continued grief journey, find some tips and tricks, hear from others about their grief journey and know you are not alone. description:
Laila France is the host and creator of The Laila France Show, a podcast dedicated to helping women prepare for life’s unexpected moments and feel more confident about what comes next. 

After the sudden loss of her husband, Laila found herself navigating grief, finances, legal matters, estate planning, health, family responsibilities, and major life decisions she never expected to face alone. Her experience became a mission: to help other women know before they need to. 
Through weekly conversations with trusted experts, The Laila France Show provides practical guidance on financial preparedness, legal and estate planning, women’s health and wellness, mental health, grief, resilience, personal growth, and reinvention. 

With honest conversations, actionable advice, and stories of hope, Laila empowers women to ask important questions, prepare for the unexpected, navigate life transitions, and build a more secure and empowered future.

title: Shirley B
author: Shirley B
description: I hope that every time you tune in, you will leave inspired, motivated, and encouraged to run into your purpose. Some of our conversations will be spiritual, rooted in faith, the Word of God, and the journey of becoming all that God has called us to be. Other conversations will be motivational, practical, and designed to encourage you in your everyday life. I desire to remind you that your life has purpose, your story has meaning, and your journey is not over. No matter what you have been through, where you are today, or how many times you may have fallen, you can still get up, move forward, and step into the purpose that God has placed inside of you. So, wherever you are and whatever season you may be walking through, I want you to know that this podcast is a place where you can be encouraged, empowered, challenged, and inspired. Don't just listen; take the message with you. Apply it to your life. Grow from it. And most importantly, run into purpose! Welcome, and let's begin this journey together

title: Created to Heal
author: Lindsay Piersol
description:
If you’re a Christian woman who is tired of not feeling like yourself—struggling with your health, overwhelmed by the demands of life, or feeling disconnected from your body and your purpose—Created to Heal is for you. 
Each week, we’ll explore how to steward the body God has entrusted to you using biblical truth, creation-based health principles, and practical strategies that help you make lasting changes in your health.
Hosted by Family Nurse Practitioner, Certified Nutrition Coach, and Certified Stress Management & Recovery Coach Lindsay Piersol, Created to Heal brings together clinical experience, faith, and Lindsay’s personal journey of healing from autoimmune disease. Through that journey, she developed the seven pillars of Created to Heal—nutrition, movement, mindset, sleep & recovery, stress management, detoxification, and spiritual health—a framework designed to help you better understand and work with the way God created your body.
Through practical teaching, personal experiences, and conversations with expert guests, you’ll learn how to apply these seven pillars to your everyday life, create sustainable habits, and become a better steward of your body, mind, and spirit—so you can move beyond simply getting through the day and begin to heal, grow, and thrive.
Want more support on your Created to Heal journey? Visit LiveLoveliBrand.com to explore coaching, programs, and resources designed to help you put these principles into practice.

It’s like a high school love all over again. A crush, the chemistry and history, no matter how crowded the room is, the only one that matters is the one that you are in love in. Dating disasters. Relationship drama. Sex, friendship, red flags, questionable decisions, and all the messy little situations we pretend we have figured out.

Hey Sis, Listen… is a voicemail-styled podcast for women who are doing their best, but still sometimes need a reminder that they’re enough. And some days I’ll tell you about yourself, lovingly, because that’s what sisters do! These messages are meant to meet you where you are. No fixing. No pressure. author: Doug Hauenstein & Max
description:
Is AI working with you — or against you? Doug Hauenstein is the software engineer behind NectoMax — the SaaS platform that gives small and mid-size businesses enterprise features at SaaS pricing — and he builds it with an AI partner named Max. Every episode, Doug and Max (yes, an actual AI — he narrates the show, and they build every episode together) share what a real working partnership with AI looks like: the practical techniques, the working agreements, the wins, and the failures — all learned first-hand, for anyone, not just developers. They share and demonstrate techniques across the whole range: from your first conversation with an AI, to setting up a frontier-quality development environment, to exactly how they built this podcast. AI is moving too fast for the how-to books. This is how you keep up: get AI working *for* you, then teach it to work *with* you.
New here? Start at the beginning — Episode 1: From Tool to Colleague. Every episode pairs with a chapter and a template at https://learn.nectomax.com
